title: Left and Right · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Left and Right · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Place three objects in a clear row on a table. A partner asks which object is immediately left or right of the middle object. The lead names the correct object from the agreed viewpoint. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: Three household objects.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Left and Right, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The lead names the correct object from the agreed viewpoint.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The lead names the correct object from the agreed viewpoint.
